Aadhaar Card must contain Name, Date of Birth, Gender, and Aadhaar Number.
PAN Card must contain Name, Father's Name, Date of Birth, and PAN Number.
Educational Qualification Document must contain Student/Applicant Name, Date of Birth, Institution/School, Examination/Qualification Details, and Result/Marks.
Internship/Experience Certificate must contain Employee/Candidate Name, Organization Name, Internship/Employment Role, Start Date, and End Date.
Driving License must contain Name, Date of Birth, Driving License Number, and License Validity.
COVID-19 Vaccination Certificate must contain Name, Date of Birth, Vaccination Status, Vaccination Dose Details, and Certificate/Reference Number.
